revision: Each major deliverable includes up to two rounds of revisions unless otherwise specified.
payment: Project timelines may pause if invoices remain unpaid beyond the agreed payment period.

timeline: Project timelines depend on timely client feedback, approvals, and asset delivery.
Milestones depend on timely client feedback, access, content, approvals, and third-party provider availability.

Client content and assets arriving after development starts
Hosting, domain, and third-party plugin ownership left undefined
Advanced animation or integration requests treated as basic build work
